MEET THE ARTIST / 최유리

Choi Yu Ree

Choi Yu Ree is a folk singer-songwriter whose warm, reflective songs begin with everyday feelings. A grand-prize winner at the 29th Yoo Jae-ha Music Contest, she made her official debut with the EP Shape in 2020.

FOLK / 2022

Forest숲

Live performance

View release on Apple Music ↗

“Forest” turns the feeling of being small among others into an image of trees growing together. Choi Yu Ree wrote and composed the song for her 2022 single release Stroll. Here, it is heard in an official Bugs-ker live session.
